item.title: Homebuyer Couple Win Court Order for BD20,000 Refund
item.description: A couple who tried to buy a BD145,000 home have won a High Civil Court order requiring the seller and her guarantor to repay BD20,000, along with court costs and a contribution towards lawyer’s fees. item.description: The emirate of Dubai is boosting its use of advanced technology to improve quality of life, deploying artificial intelligence and smart data analytics across its public beaches to enhance safety and speed up emergency response. item.title: Saudi Non-Oil Exports Surge 20.7% And Trade Surplus Soars 70% In November 2025
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s non-oil exports recorded a significant increase of 20.7 percent during November 2025 compared to the same month in 2024. It was revealed in the report of the international merchandise trade for November 2025, released on Sunday by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority explained that national non-oil exports, excluding re-exports, posted a growth of 4.7 percent while re-exported goods recorded a substantial increase of 53.1 percent. item.title: Saudi Arabia: Commerce Ministry Recalls 1,778 BAIC BJ40 Vehicles Due To A Defective Brake System
item.description: The Ministry of Commerce announced on Sunday the recall of 1,778 BAIC BJ40 model vehicles manufactured between 2021 and 2025 due to a defective brake system. It was detected that there is a defect in the brake booster that could impair the braking system’s operation while driving, increasing the risk of an accident. item.title: GCC Population Set To Reach 83.6m By 2050 As Region Ages Rapidly
item.description: The total population of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC ) countries is projected to reach approximately 83.6m by 2050, according to population projections from the United Nations. item.title: NEOM: Saudi Arabia Postpones 2029 Asian Winter Games
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Olympic Committee and the Olympic Council of Asia agreed to postpone the 2029 Asian Winter Games, which the kingdom was to host at a showpiece mountain resort that forms part of its NEOM mega‑project, a statement on Saturday said. item.description: Airlines including Emirates and Qatar Airways have cancelled flights to the US amid devastating winter storms causing travel chaos across North America.
